query: moss/fastlane-1 cached input tokens price per million

text: Moss charges $0.03 per 1M cached input tokens on moss/fastlane-1 (vs. $0.25 / 1M for regular input tokens and $1.75 / 1M for output tokens). Cached tokens are prompt tokens already held in the prefix cache from an earlier call, such as a repeated system prompt or earlier conversation turns.
